# Recover every original unmaterialized positive operand in the complete 1,294 replay-mismatch cohort

Raised/recorded 2026-10-07 (America/Los_Angeles). No claim, implementation or scientific execution yet. Native custody PR1383 is actually merged at `44c64776002bab7990e8f3eb1c4b7f1ef8e56320`. All six required native/helper bodies match reviewed candidate68c by whole bytes/mode/OID. Root completed #1376 acceptance, closure, canonical claim release and guarded checkout cleanup; fresh read-only GitHub snapshots confirm CLOSED and inactive claim. Actual shared readiness and canonical ownership must be confirmed before implementation.

Parent #1202; one global engineering work item. Preserve #1353's separate complete46/28+18/209 scope and all45 original numerical products. Root explicitly sequences globalALL1294 restoration FIRST;1353remainsOPEN/blocked until genuine local method remediation and complete46acceptance. The four overlapping NorthSlope mismatch members and all46siblings remain preserved; no concurrent authorclaim/writer. This proposal does not close, shrink, replace or approve1353.

## Concrete problem and fixed scope

The independent original1300 consumed-input audit found precisely1,294 original replay mismatches across494 families/49 batches. The exact selection rule is original diagnosis `status == "original-replay-mismatch"` across every row of the 32 complete retained diagnosis bodies. Independent readback finds all 26,276 original rows: 1,294 selected and 24,982 other rows. Their10,419 original recorded queries include2,512 unmaterialized complete-source-record operands. Original1300 genuinely did not consume the ZIP, and its unknown results remain valid source-free observations. Recovering missing operands is a testable global numerical reproduction problem, not proof every mismatch will resolve or proof Atlas geography is wrong.

Keep every original1,294 subject and all old diagnoses/unknowns, full current95,173 candidate reconstruction, all71 restored original physical support bodies, all32 original diagnosis products containing the cohort, full original routing/current context and source/container/frame lineage. The original source geometry/coordinate order is immutable.2512 marker-only and2530 marker-parent counts do not substitute for the complete10,419 query/ancestor source closure.

## Minimal implementation

Use the existing1353 `reader.load` candidate-only reconstruction and original `trace.original_levels` operand restoration. Change native acquisition to the actually accepted `reader.consume_native` over three ordinary source aliases; never call legacy `original_native`, `load_source` or instantiate `legacy.transport.Context`, which reads the ZIP. Ordinary source getters must reject all undeclared ZIP/foreign/body/OID/vintage requests before any operator. Upstream member index ZIP fields remain provenance only. No preflight-only exclusion followed by a hidden fallback.

Authenticate the entire95,809,336-byte native member and188,612 headers before the real source consumer runs. Preserve native ordinals/offsets/record/coordinate hashes, container/ancestor flags, original GMT longitude conversion and each query's explicit periodic offset. Decode every contributing source and parent record from those complete native bytes with the unchanged original104 decoder. Restore every supported positive operand, including complete-source-record markers in original duplicate/query order and non-marker witnesses; retain empty/nonpolygon/zero-area/invalid/unknown context instead of discarding it.

Use the unchanged original104 comparison/alternating operators. Compare all six complete support mappings and three hierarchy mappings against each restored original scientific row. Preserve every fresh complete mapping, source query and exact equality flag. If mismatch/invalid/source/container/unsupported/operation failure remains, emit an explicit retained unknown. No original contradiction attribution before exact nine-map parity, no coordinate normalization, epsilon, repair, new water/land truth or political assignment.

## Acceptance

1. Freeze the complete actual source/input/code/import/callable/runtime closure before input-only and two genuine complete1,294 executions. Use current shared Baseline/NewVintage, exact row/join and finite-metric helpers for applicable invariants, or an explicitly independently reviewed equivalent at the actual reader/writer boundary. Pre-admit fresh exclusive destinations and the entire encoded/decoded publication set; a partial attempt has no completion receipt. Preserve original1300 diagnoses, original104 measurements and old1353 unadmitted ZIP-dependent attempts at their literal vintages. Do not relabel these as v8/current-global observations.
2. Authenticate full195 original ordinary inputs plus three actual native source aliases and required member-index/reader/runtime/whole operand-adapter bodies. Actual reads must reconcile to the declared whole body roster including metadata, source snapshots and helper/caller imports. All95,173 original/current candidate bindings and full scoped/complement identity partitions must pass before operators.
3. Retain all1,294 results/494 families/49 batches/10,419 queries and all complete contributing source/parent pointsets. Emit full original/new six-plus-three mappings or strictly reversible ordinary whole-object aliases with actual complete-containing-byte custody, exact field/ID/size/hash and reconstruction. Changed maps cannot be replaced by a hash or original reference. No old object reference is silently dereferenced from an excluded file.
4. Two complete same-freeze runs must retain real times/commands/runtime/terminal outcomes and complete outputs. Byte-identical scientific payload may be delivered once only after independent full encoded/decoded tree comparison, with both original reports and preserved trees. No third global world generation or native compiler.
5. Directed real-entry controls cover foreign/duplicate/omitted subject and full95,173 routing/complement membership; source-before-operator guards; whole-source marker, duplicated/query-ordered/periodic operands; source/header/container/frame drift; missing/reordered/wrong/trailing/overbound native bodies; invalid geometry/operator failure and nine-map mismatch unknowns; canonical signed-zero/shape differences; wrong ordinary alias and whole restoration; actual imported/callable/runtime mutation. A stale unrelated checksum must not mask the intended branch.
6. Actual standard admission and strictscope, distinct exact-head substantive review, hostedCI, normal single queue, actual merge full-byte/mode readback, original acceptance reconciliation and guarded lifecycle are mandatory. Parent1202 stays unfinished. Source/physical/political/repair approval remains unknown.

## Measured inputs and unresolved output budget

The previous198-input floor is232,416,373 encoded bytes. Required native member-index/reader/runtime bindings and the literal original operand-adapter wholebody add real small dependencies; the attached complete source plan measures the updated 202-source roster at exactly 232,466,132 encoded bytes, leaving 35,969,324 bytes before new code, controls, actual reports and outputs. All ordinary encoded AND decoded bodies obey33,554,432B; aggregate268,435,456B/descriptors512 remain unchanged. Inputs leave about36MB before new code/controls/two reports and scientific outputs. Output fit is NOT proved: no new scientific products exist yet.

Favor one full global recovery PR using existing codec and strict whole-object inverse aliases. Max2 PRs provides only a genuinely measured scope-preserving delivery continuation if unavoidable, not automatic infrastructure or regional pilot stages. If actual scientific outputs exceed closure, preserve them completely and report the admission blocker; never drop members/query bodies, alter coordinates or waive caps. Measure operating storage and actual source/output closure before each full run/publication.

Fresh full open issue/PR/comments and canonical ownership scans must resolve the1353 overlap and any new global numerical work. Shared readiness must check actual CLOSED1376/1300/1261, actual merged native byte/mode equivalence, exact contract pins and complete scope; root has completed #1376 lifecycle; repeat actual dependency/claim/overlap checks after issue creation and immediately before any ready/claim transition. Proposed machine source pins are actual whole containing bodies, never virtual95MB/member or per-entry canonical hashes.

## Fresh precreation ownership/readiness disposition

Fresh complete open inventory (627 records and three open PRs) has no overlapping proposed owned prefix. Exact scoped subject overlap exists with source-only #1390 (Azores: three mismatch components) and #1355 (East Kalimantan: six mismatch components), plus four North Slope mismatch components in blocked #1353. Preserve the full overlap IDs and families in the attached complete scope proof. Source researchers may continue against their pinned original observations; this job changes numerical reproduction evidence only, never their source packets or original source authority. Root must coordinate the numerical successor handoff so no old source-research observation is silently relabeled as recovered/current. #1353 has an inactive canonical claim and no live work; its full acceptance remains separate and blocked.
